description: Run a coding task: write code, fix bugs, add features, refactor. The AI agent clones the repo, makes changes, and opens a PR. Returns the result and PR URL when complete.

base_branch.description: Branch to base changes on (default: main)

repo.description: GitHub repo in owner/repo format, e.g. 'facebook/react'

task.description: Task description, e.g. 'Fix the login bug' or 'Add dark mode to the settings page'

name: run_task
